title: Item and NPC contracts
description: Items and NPCs, the things containment moves and holds (21 §8 Containment; 03 §23; 00 §4.4; 00a §5, §12), owned by containment (capability_registry.json). R5 slice 4: what take, drop and give need. Each is a RuntimeEntity: a fresh world gives it an EntityId (numeric profile, Initial world ids) and one container, the only place its location is stored (03 §23); a holder's contents and an actor's inventory are derived from it. Text follows the four LegendMUD tiers (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q1): keywords the player types, a short description for action messages and the inventory, a room line for the room's contents, and a description for examine. An item's equipment slot joins with equipment@1 (chapter-one slice c1-equipment); stacking, weight and put join with their capabilities as optional fields.

NameWords.description: Name words: bare, the text key of the name with no article ("lantern"); optionally article, the article a presenter puts before bare (a, an or the); optionally plural, the text key of the plural ("lanterns"). short stays the phrase narration binds; words exist for presenters that compose a sentence from several names. Each key is in the text catalog.

bare.description: Text key of the name with no article.

article.description: The article a presenter puts before bare.

ItemLocation.description: Where the item is when the game starts: in a room, held by an NPC, or inside another item.

oneOf.description: Starts inside another item of this cartridge.
Starts nowhere: it is a copy source only, and exists in play only once another rule makes a copy.

SlotKey.description: An equipment slot: the thirteen keys. A fresh world makes one holder entity inside the body per slot some item declares, capacity 2 for finger and 1 for every other slot (numeric profile, Slot holder ids).

ItemAffect.description: Adds an amount to an attribute while the item is worn or the status lasts, such as strength +1. Use a negative amount to lower it.

ItemDefinition.description: An item: something the player can pick up, carry, wear or open. It has names and text, where it starts, and optional parts such as being a container, a worn slot, a lid or a weight.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

words.description: The item's name words, such as the bare name lantern, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows while it lies there.

room_line_variants.description: Room line variants; first match wins.

location.description: Where a fresh world puts it.

capacity.description: Most items held directly; receptacles only.

slot.description: The slot it is worn in.

equip.description: Authored wear and remove words: the Wear and Remove labels and the worn and removed lines. Only with slot; each key is in the text catalog.

worn.description: The line told when the item is worn.

removed.description: The line told when the item is removed.

affects.description: Attribute bonuses the item gives while worn, such as +1 strength.

identified.description: A true-or-false fact: the item counts as identified, and its bonuses show, while the fact is true.

intended_level.description: For balancing only: the level this item is meant for, read by the power report (needs affects). It does not change play.

barrier.description: The barrier on it, a container lid.

mass_grams.description: The item shell mass in grams, excluding its contents. Required on every item under world.carry; explicit zero is valid.

give_allowed.description: False prevents ordinary Give of this item or any container holding it transitively; absence permits Give when contents allow it. Dialogue hand_over remains legal.

container.description: Only explicitly authored receptacles hold items. Absence is false; capacity and barrier require this field.

fuel.description: Makes the item a lightable fuel source that burns while lit, or a supply that refuels one.

weapon.description: Makes the item a weapon: the skill needed and its attack.

block_chance.description: Percent chance that this shield blocks while held.

vessel.description: Makes the item hold liquid: how much, and what is in it at the start.

readable.description: Lets the player read the item, and optionally learn a topic from it.

edible.description: Makes the item food: what eating it restores, cures or applies.

bandage.description: Makes the item a bandage that can treat bleeding.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this item; each names a status of this game.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this item: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

ambient.description: Ambient lines told while the player is in this item's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines, every, chance?, when?}.

locks.description: Conditions to take this item (get) or put things into it (put); a player who fails one is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take this item or anything inside it.

put.description: A condition the player must meet to put something into this container.

Tag.description: A tag on an item, barrier or room, from a fixed list; conditions test for it with has_tag. Some tags do something: a room tagged air, chasm or water admits only a body with a status that allows it, and the world's terrain settings can make moving into a road or marsh room cost more or less.

DamageKind.description: A damage kind: a closed engine vocabulary shared by attack profiles and NPC resistances. A row that needs a new kind adds it here; a kind never shares a name with a Tag.

ResistancePercent.description: A resistance percent: negative is a weakness.

Resistances.description: How much less damage the NPC takes, in percent, from each kind of damage and from weapons of each material tag; negative means a weakness.

cold.description: Percent resistance to `cold` damage. Negative is a weakness.

fire.description: Percent resistance to `fire` damage. Negative is a weakness.

physical.description: Percent resistance to `physical` damage. Negative is a weakness.

poison.description: Percent resistance to `poison` damage. Negative is a weakness.

burnable.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `burnable`. Negative is a weakness.

cool.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `cool`. Negative is a weakness.

cursed.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `cursed`. Negative is a weakness.

exposed.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `exposed`. Negative is a weakness.

fragile.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `fragile`. Negative is a weakness.

lamp.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `lamp`. Negative is a weakness.

liquid_holding.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `liquid_holding`. Negative is a weakness.

metal.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `metal`. Negative is a weakness.

rod.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `rod`. Negative is a weakness.

sharp.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `sharp`. Negative is a weakness.

silver.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `silver`. Negative is a weakness.

warm.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `warm`. Negative is a weakness.

waterproof.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `waterproof`. Negative is a weakness.

windproof.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `windproof`. Negative is a weakness.

wooden.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `wooden`. Negative is a weakness.

air.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `air`. Negative is a weakness.

chasm.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `chasm`. Negative is a weakness.

water.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `water`. Negative is a weakness.

bed.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `bed`. Negative is a weakness.

forge.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `forge`. Negative is a weakness.

rug.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `rug`. Negative is a weakness.

marsh.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `marsh`. Negative is a weakness.

road.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `road`. Negative is a weakness.

NpcDefinition.description: A character other than the player: its key, words, name, room line and description as for an item, the room it starts in, and optionally how many items it carries, its daily schedule, its health, and names and descriptions that change with conditions.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

words.description: The NPC's name words, such as the bare name guard, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows.

room.description: The room a fresh world puts it in.

daily_schedule.description: Where the NPC goes during the day. Each key is an hour, such as 6 or 20; from that hour until the next listed one the NPC belongs in that room. The value is a room, or a list of cases tried in order. Example: {"6": "market", "20": "home"}.

disposition.description: How the NPC treats the player: hostile while hostile holds, else friendly while friendly holds, else wary. A hostile NPC refuses talk and trade and, with engage, attacks a player who walks in, or with arrest sends them to arrest.to; a friendly one gives its friendly discount.

hostile.description: While this condition holds, the NPC is hostile: it will not talk or trade, and may attack.

friendly.description: While this condition holds (and hostile does not), the NPC is friendly.

engage.description: Said when this hostile NPC engages a player who walks in.

arrest.description: Instead of engage: this hostile NPC stops a player who walks in, and no encounter opens.

to.description: The room the arrested body goes to.

narration.description: Said when the player is arrested.

refuse.description: The line shown on the NPC's page while it is hostile; it names the mood, not the reason.

ask.description: What the NPC says when asked about a topic. The first answer whose topic matches and whose condition holds is told and teaches its grants topic; with none, the NPC does not know.

unknown.description: What the NPC says when no answer matches the topic.

answers.description: What the NPC answers, topic by topic.

topic.description: The topic this answer is for.

text.description: What the NPC says when asked about this topic.

when.description: This answer is used only while this condition holds.

grants.description: Granted when this answer is given.

schedule_cases.description: Toolbox row W10: conditional hours of daily_schedule. Each key is an hour daily_schedule lists (checked by the compiler); when that hour's job runs, the NPC goes to the room of the first case whose condition holds, else to the hour's daily_schedule room (the fallback). The source form is a daily_schedule hour mapped to [case, ..., room], which the compiler splits into the two fields.

hp.description: The NPC's hit points: minimum, maximum and starting value.

resource_starts.description: Starting value of each named resource.

unattackable.description: This NPC can never be attacked and never starts a fight. An arrest still applies. If absent, it can be attacked when it has an attack profile.

attack.description: How the NPC fights: chance to hit and damage range.

shop.description: Makes the NPC a shopkeeper: the items offered, their prices and the lines told on buying and selling.

perception.description: Hides the NPC until a fact is true.

discovered.description: A fact that must be true for this NPC to be visible.

spawn_template.description: Not placed in a fresh world; used as a population template.

drops.description: Loot table: in order, an item this NPC holds at genesis and its percent chance of passing to the corpse when combat kills the NPC; a failed item stays with the dead NPC.

item.description: An item of this cartridge held by this NPC.

chance.description: Percent chance, 1 to 100, that the item stays on the corpse; otherwise it is kept back.

resistances.description: How much less damage the NPC takes, in percent, from each kind of damage and from weapons of each material tag; negative means a weakness.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this NPC; each names a status of this game.

attributes.description: This NPC's attribute values, used when a check is made against it and for its attack. An attribute left out has its starting value.

attribute.description: A cartridge attribute, read by opposed checks.

value.description: This NPC's value of the attribute.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this NPC: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

ambient.description: Ambient lines or emotes told while the player is in this NPC's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines | emotes, every, chance?, when?}.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds; otherwise taking it is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds.

mount.description: This NPC can be ridden (needs mount in the world settings). While a character rides it, the character can only move into rooms with one of terrain, each move costs cost_percent of the usual (default 100), and the NPC moves along. Not on a spawn template.

terrain.description: Room tags this mount carries a rider over; a move into a room with none of them is refused. 1 to 8 unique tags.

cost_percent.description: Percent, 0 to 1000, applied last to the rider's move cost, rounded down. Absent: the cost is not scaled.

NameVariants.description: Other names for this item or NPC, each used while its condition holds; the first that matches wins. Each can have its own name words.

when.description: This name is used only while this condition holds.

description.description: Text key of the short name used while this variant applies.

words.description: The name words for this name, such as the bare name and plural.

TextVariants.description: Other versions of this text, each used while its condition holds; the first that matches wins, else the base text shows.

ScheduleCases.description: Toolbox row W10: the cases of one conditional schedule hour, tried in order when the hour's job runs: the first whose when holds (an absent when holds; read with the player as the actor, the NPC as the target and the clock at the job's due time) names the room. A walks case moves only along a path (toolbox row W26). A case's optional goal is narration shown when the NPC leaves the player's room by that case.

items.description: One case of the hour: where the NPC goes, and optionally why and how.

when.description: This case is used only while this condition holds; leave it out to always match.

room.description: The room the NPC moves to when this case is chosen.

goal.description: Text key told when the NPC leaves the player's room by this case; silent if the player does not see it go.

walks.description: The step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

attacks.description: Swings: how many swings one opportunity makes, each rolled on its own, their damage summed (1 to 10; default 1).

crit.description: A hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent of all attacks, sharing the accuracy draw: a hit whose draw is below this is critical, so a chance above the accuracy makes every hit critical.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

ShopOffer.description: One exact authored shop item definition with its positive buy and sell prices; custody determines availability.

stock.description: Sell from this identity set, items[0] the offer's item, at buy[n-1] while the shopkeeper directly holds n of it; buy has one entry per item and buy[0] equals the offer's buy.

items.description: The interchangeable items sold as one offer; the first is the offer's item.

buy.description: Buy prices by count held: entry n is the price while the shopkeeper holds n of the items; one entry per item.

stolen.description: This shopkeeper is a fence; sell takes only an instance whose world.theft stolen fact is true, and a shop without it only one whose fact is false. Never on a stock offer.

Shop.description: A finite NPC shop: conserved resource, exact authored item offers and committed purchase/sale narration keys.

resource.description: The conserved resource prices are paid in.

bought.description: Text key of the purchase narration.

sold.description: Text key of the sale narration.

buy_discount.description: A discount on buying: the price is multiplied by numerator / denominator (rounded down, at least minimum) while the player has the skill or the shopkeeper is friendly.

skill.description: The discount applies while the actor has this skill usable. Give this or friendly.

friendly.description: Must be true: the discount applies while the shop's NPC is friendly to the actor. Give this or skill.

numerator.description: Multiplies the buy price; see denominator.

denominator.description: Divides the buy price; the price is floor(buy times numerator over denominator).

minimum.description: The discounted buy price is never below this.

FuelRow.description: Exact-instance fuel history: bounded remaining charge, confirmed settlement time and stored ignition state. Supplies are never lit.

oneOf.description: A lightable item that burns fuel while lit, and is refilled from a supply item.

capacity.description: The most fuel the source holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

rate.description: Fuel burned per logical time unit while lit; at least 1. It goes out when the fuel runs out.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; the supply must use the same one.

supply.description: The supply item that refuels it; the supply's unit must match.

ignited.description: Text key of the line told when it is lit.

doused.description: Text key of the line told when it is put out.

refueled.description: Text key of the line told when it is refilled.

cues.description: Cues active only while this source is lit.

oneOf.description: An item that holds fuel for refilling sources; it is emptied by what it gives.

capacity.description: The most fuel the supply holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; a source takes only a supply with the same one.

FuelSpec.description: Immutable authored source or supply metadata; sources bind one compatible supply and their narration keys.

ammo.description: The resource pool one unit of which each shot spends.

ranged.description: The weapon shoots in an encounter's round 1, spending one of the body's ammo resource pool; it never strikes in melee.

fact.description: The bounded int fact that holds the weapon's durability.

wear.description: Durability each of the weapon's hits takes off.

durability.description: The bounded int entity fact holding this weapon's durability (its default is a new weapon's) and the amount each hit of its own attack takes off; at the fact's minimum it is broken and strikes unarmed.

WeaponProfile.description: An equipped weapon's required skill and authored attack profile.

ItemReadable.description: One explicit held-item Read, with optional declared Boolean topic grant.

label.description: Text key of the read action's button.

text.description: Text key of what the player reads.

topic.description: A topic the reader learns on reading.

AppliedStatus.description: A status this food or drink puts on the player, with an optional duration in game time units that replaces the status's own. Eating again while it lasts keeps whichever end is later.

status.description: The status it applies, such as poisoned.

duration.description: How long it lasts, in game time units; replaces the status's own length.

ItemEdible.description: Held-food metadata; a complete original item grants its effect (capped recovery, cures, applies) when Consume commits.

resource.description: The pool eating restores (for example mv); with amount, or neither.

amount.description: Positive integer; the canonical numeric profile supplies the safe-integer upper limit.

label.description: Text key of the eat action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when it is eaten.

cures.description: Statuses this food ends when eaten; the player may eat it while one is active even when full.

applies.description: Statuses Consume applies to the eater's body after the recovery and any cures, through the shared status apply (status_applied on a first application, immune holds, a refresh is silent); none may modify an hp-maximum attribute.

ItemBandage.description: A directly held item opted into exact bleed treatment.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable to bandage.

action.description: Must be bandage: the key of the action that applies it.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when the bandage is applied.

Cue.description: Something a listener hears, smells or feels from its source. sense: sound, smell or heat; text: the line, in that sense's words; range: how many rooms away it carries through exits, 0 (same room only) to 2; when: an optional condition on the listener. The room, detail, item, NPC, lit light, status or action outcome that declares it is its source.

range.description: Rooms it carries through exits, 0 to 2.

when.description: A condition read for the listener.

Cues.description: A source's sense cues, in authored order.

AmbientSet.description: Lines told now and then: each time the clock passes a multiple of every and the chance passes, one of the lines is shown. A room, item or NPC shows at most one ambient line each time the clock moves on.

every.description: Logical seconds between chances; a set is due when the clock crosses a multiple of it.

chance.description: Percent chance it fires when due, 1 to 100; 100 when absent.

when.description: A condition read with the entity as target (a room has none); the first set whose when holds is the active one.

NpcAmbientSet.description: Things an NPC says or does now and then: give either lines or emotes, not both.

emotes.description: The emotes it picks from, 1 to 8.

every.description: Logical seconds between chances; a set is due when the clock crosses a multiple of it.

chance.description: Percent chance it fires when due, 1 to 100; 100 when absent.

when.description: A condition read with the entity as target (a room has none); the first set whose when holds is the active one.

AmbientSets.description: The ambient lines of a room or item, in order.

NpcAmbientSets.description: An NPC's ambient sets, each lines or emotes, in authored order.
